items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This is with you, Don Ferrara, Sal Mosca, Peter Ind, and Shadow Wilson from May of nineteen fifty seven.

ctx.x: You know the great Mel Brooks line in “The 2000 Year Old Man”? He said: “Wow, you must have a lot of children.” [the other says] “I have thousands of children and they never write and say ‘How you doing, Pop?’”
Here we are, Very Cool. This is with you, Don Ferrara, Sal Mosca, Peter Ind, and Shadow Wilson from May of nineteen fifty seven.
Oh yeah. That was at Rudy Van Gelder’s.
